name: All-wheel-drive turbo six
notes: An all-wheel-drive sports coupe with a dual-clutch six: 1550 kg, 55 % on the front, sport tyres, 35 % of the torque to the front through a centre differential with a viscous coupling, a clutch-pack rear. The numbers are a typical all-wheel-drive turbo coupe's, not one model's. The car part of a build: pair it with a turbocharged six of some 3 L.
